name: Circus Lupus
label: Dischord
lede: A Wisconsin band that moved to DC, sounded like the Fall in a pinball machine, and got Joan Jett to produce their single.

eras.title: An Ignition bassist finds his voice in Madison
eras.text: Chris Thomson had played bass in DC's Ignition. At school in Madison, Wisconsin, he put the bass down, picked up the mic, and built a band around words and jagged guitar.

years.p: [[Chris Thomson|e79601f0-2aa6-415c-886e-570aea8acea1]] from [[Ignition|3cb2b7d6-1f0b-4ac5-b67f-52132f3d3b61]] sings, with [[Chris Hamley|b3264bfd-2c4a-44fa-85f9-d2f9f293064d]] on guitar, [[Arika Casebolt|4ffc2835-8d6d-4c82-adc6-19297bdedaf5]] on drums and Reg Shrader on bass. Dischord dates the band from spring 1990.
Circus Lupus' first tape, a nine-song cassette that Dischord later carried in its distribution catalog as LG1.
Circus Lupus' first single, Tightrope Walker backed with Chinese Nitro, comes out on Pittsburgh's Cubist Records.

eras.title: Spastic and angular in DC
eras.text: The move to Washington cost Circus Lupus its bassist, Reg Shrader, and got it a label, Dischord. In a town still measuring every band against Fugazi, Circus Lupus sounded more like the Fall: sideways vocals, riffs that seemed to fight each other.

years.h: Circus Lupus moves to D.C.; [[Seth Lorinczi|ae764a61-4f4c-4018-b598-e14a8802a7f3]] takes over bass
years.p: Bassist Reg Shrader doesn't make the move from Madison. Seth Lorinczi takes his place and stays until Circus Lupus ends in 1993.
The split with Chicago's Trenchmouth carries Sea of Serenity and Heathen and comes out on Skene! and Dischord, per Wikipedia.

q: Playing against one another in a race to get to the finish line.
years.p: Circus Lupus' first album. Trouser Press heard Chris Thomson in Mark E. Smith mode and a band that was proof punk still had teeth beyond [[Fugazi|233fc3f3-6de2-465c-985e-e721dbabbace]].
years.xp: Reviewers reached for motion words: a ricocheting pinball of wailing vocals and snaking riffs, as one put it, with what Team Rock called a scuzzy, grungy undercurrent. The playing sounds deliberately unsteady, four people pulling at the same song from different ends.

eras.title: Joan Jett in the booth
eras.text: Circus Lupus' last year brought Joan Jett producing a Dischord single and a second album, Solid Brass, that pushed the angles further. By summer 1993 the band was over.

years.cap: Pop Man / Pressure Point, Dischord No. 73
years.p: Dischord's No. 73 pairs Pop Man with Pressure Point, with Joan Jett producing. Dischord calls it one of her first production jobs since she worked with The Germs in 1979.
years.xp: Jett had produced the Germs' (GI) in 1979, and there's not much between that and this in the label's telling. Both songs later rode along at the end of Solid Brass, next to a second, different version of Pop Man.

years.p: Circus Lupus' second and final album, recorded at Inner Ear. Trouser Press called it caustic and densely angular.
years.xp: Song titles include Right Turn Clyde, New Cop Car and Deviant Gesture Catalog.

years.p: Dischord gives Circus Lupus' run as spring 1990 to summer 1993: three years, two albums, a handful of singles.

eras.title: Antimony, Las Mordidas, The Monorchid
eras.text: Circus Lupus split down the middle: singer Chris Thomson went one way, Chris Hamley, Seth Lorinczi and Arika Casebolt stayed together as Antimony, and then Thomson and Hamley reunited in The Monorchid.

years.p: Chris Hamley, Seth Lorinczi and Arika Casebolt release Antimony's Phantom Itch, which Trouser Press said carried on Circus Lupus' thorny dynamism. Chris Thomson starts the groove-punk band [[Las Mordidas|6e471c60-ce00-4d4e-a2af-b61fa6e95574]].

years.h: Chris Thomson and Chris Hamley form [[The Monorchid|69dbd702-9073-49dd-b73a-67c33f030a4f]]
years.p: Trouser Press lists Andy Cone, Andy Coronado and Tom Allnutt alongside them. Let Them Eat Monorchid comes in 1996 and Who Put Out the Fire? in 1998, after The Monorchid ended.
years.xp: Seth Lorinczi later formed [[The Quails|1c87cd77-3048-4e06-96e6-f5a52b5f60e9]] in San Francisco.

years.h: Circus Lupus' Super Genius back in print
years.p: Dischord reissues Circus Lupus' first album, Super Genius, per Wikipedia. The second, Solid Brass, is now out of print on CD and LP and lives on digitally.
